entries.01451552806d2524: Rental of equipment and materials and related services
entries.02d7c4e6db65e1ef: The business model is to rent out construction and equipment-installation machinery and event equipment to work sites of construction companies and others and to event organizers, while also providing sales, electrical equipment installation and transportation services.
entries.0d63aab7dea37e02: This business centers on Nishio Rent All Co., Ltd., and rents and sells construction and facility equipment, such as civil engineering and road machinery, aerial work machinery, building machinery and surveying instruments, as well as event-related equipment.
entries.1ea1aae9f8cd8b13: Machinery for tunnel and dam construction
entries.248b58f9dc9eb5a2: This business centers on Nishio Rent All Co., Ltd., and rents and sells construction and facility equipment, such as civil engineering and road machinery, aerial work machinery, building machinery and surveying instruments, as well as event-related equipment. It also includes rental of generators and tunnel and dam construction machinery, electrical construction work, contracted operation services for construction machinery, and transportation. In addition to Japan, it also operates overseas in Malaysia, Thailand, Vietnam, Singapore, Australia and other countries. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥207,157 million, accounting for the majority of consolidated revenue.
entries.2953c7e1cd1d9d8d: This is a business not included in the reportable segments.
entries.311fa9d189ef0662: Its main customers are companies carrying out construction and equipment-installation work and event organizers, and there are no specific customers accounting for 10% or more of consolidated revenue. The majority of revenue is generated in Japan.
entries.381b1557ee1220a0: Its corporate motto is “Our group contributes to the economy and society as a pioneer of the comprehensive rental business,” and it constantly pursues the benefits of rental use from the user's perspective and strives for product development and system building. Under its medium-term management plan, “Next Stage 2026” (fiscal years ended September 2024 to September 2026), it is concretely commercializing “Construction Logistics,” which combines the construction equipment rental business with the transportation and logistics business, and “Temporary Power,” which combines the construction equipment rental business with the event business, and it plans to pursue M&A in high-growth overseas markets. It plans revenue of ¥220 billion for the fiscal year ended September 2026.
entries.39f479b745643e47: Customers at construction sites and events
entries.444c5ac95f2ee93d: This business is not included in the reportable segments. It imports and sells overseas-made construction machinery, manufactures fasteners, maintains, manufactures and sells construction machinery, works as a non-life insurance agency, and manages and operates real estate within the group. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥7,797 million.
entries.4f47cf566d6e9d38: It pioneered comprehensive rental by starting rental of road machinery in 1965, and it holds a wide range of rental assets, from civil engineering and road machinery to aerial work platforms, surveying instruments and event equipment. Because the group can also handle electrical installation work, transportation and operation services for construction machinery, it has a structure to meet construction-site demand in an integrated way.
entries.5745c9511e56c9d8: The group consists of the company, 43 subsidiaries and one affiliate, and the company, as a holding company, manages the group companies. Consolidated number of employees as of September 30, 2025 is 4,842.
entries.8255867b5c563cfa: With Nishio Rent All Co., Ltd. at its core, the company rents and sells construction and equipment-installation machinery, such as civil engineering and road machinery, aerial work platforms, building machinery and surveying instruments, as well as event-related equipment. It also performs design supervision and contracting for electrical installation work for construction, contracting of operation services for construction machinery, and transportation, among others.
entries.965e3d62dcfee4e2: Net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥12,109 million, an increase of 4.4% from ¥11,599 million in the previous year.
entries.a69b2f4a3556567a: Construction and equipment-installation machinery (civil engineering and road machinery, aerial work platforms, building machinery, surveying instruments, etc.)
entries.aee71de925fe1446: Rental fees for construction and equipment-installation machinery and event equipment
entries.b1cd95ba0299ddc5: The majority of revenue comes from the rental-related business; by region, revenue is ¥189,481 million in Japan and ¥25,473 million overseas. Overseas, it has rental subsidiaries in Malaysia, Thailand, Vietnam, Singapore, Australia and others, centered on Asia and Oceania.
entries.d416df9cd3595003: Consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥214,954 million, an increase of 8.0% from ¥198,995 million in the previous year. The rental-related business accounts for the majority at ¥207,157 million.
